race.comment: SACRAMENTAL (1) looks the class of the field. He won two on the bounce and hasn't been far away in two runs since, the latest effort a fifth placing to the progressive Yauson in much harder company at Ballarat. Rates highly across the border. THERMODYNAMIC (4) booted up from the inside draw to lead last start and stuck on gamely for fifth at Murray Bridge. Comes back in grade and will be hard to run down. FOREVER WAITING (8) is on a quick turnaround after a solid third over 1400m at Mt Gambier nine days ago. Strong run last time and is among the leading chances. SAFE BET (6) raced on the speed when resuming last start but peaked on his run on straightening and faded to finish tenth over 1200m at Murray Bridge. Should park just off the speed. Don't underestimate
